text: {"label":"Augmentative Communication and Conversation Skills Training","definition":"Teaching functional and social communication, including augmentative and alternative systems, picture exchange, conversation and small-talk skills, and public speaking, often by training educators or paraeducators to deliver instruction.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on applied communication systems and conversational skill instruction, not theoretical analyses of intraverbal relations, functional communication training for problem behavior, or language acquisition and foreign-language learning."}
